title: Houston Cop Shoots at Robbery Suspects Fleeing in Stolen Car
description:
* (Disclaimer: The content in this video is intended for educational and informational purposes only)
Houston, Texas — On April 10, 2025,  HPD patrol officers were searching for a vehicle stolen in an aggravated robbery minutes earlier and located the vehicle in a parking lot at the above address. Several marked HPD patrol vehicles responded to the scene and attempted to conduct a traffic stop. As officers gave verbal commands for the suspects to exit the vehicle, the driver moved the vehicle directly toward the patrol vehicles and the officers standing outside their patrol vehicle. Officer Martin was directly in the path of the oncoming vehicle with nowhere to move. 

Officer Martin discharged his duty weapon at the vehicle, but did not strike the suspects. The vehicle narrowly missed hitting Officer Martin and fled the scene at a high rate of speed. Officers initiated a vehicle pursuit of the suspect vehicle until it became disabled in the 7600 block of Wallisville Road due to tire damage. Three adult male suspects inside the vehicle were arrested without further incident. Officers recovered three firearms, one in the vehicle and two others thrown from the vehicle during the pursuit.

One suspect, Ronny Leonardo Hernandez (driver), 18, is charged with aggravated assault of a public servant in the 209th State District Court. Two other suspects, Cristian Rolando Gutierrez Bonilla, 19, and Victor Jesus Rauda Lopez, 20, are charged with criminal trespass in Harris County Criminal Courts #3 and #5, respectively. No one was injured. Officer O. Martin, who discharged his duty weapon, was sworn in as an officer in June 2024 and is assigned to the Northeast Patrol Division.
